name: Nagira Yoshinori
source: Yoshinori Nagira is Camp Buddy's trusted head scoutmaster who leads the scouts on the various activities. Overall, he only wants what's best for the camp and the people around him, putting everyone else first at every opportunity, even to his own detriment. He has yet to find his own path through the promises he has made.
